cohort: The study included 220 women with a history of ectopic pregnancy.
finding: 20.4% of women with a history of ectopic pregnancy had sexual dysfunction, and a significant direct relationship was found between sexual function and quality of marital relationship; longer marriage duration and increased number of ectopic pregnancies were associated with decreased sexual function and quality of marital relationship, while increased spouse age was also associated with decreased quality of marital relationship.
cross-section timing: Data collected in 2022, after women had experienced ectopic pregnancy.
